vignette: A child presents with periodontitis. The dentist is considering possible causes.
stem: Which approach to determining the cause is most appropriate?

options.text: Consider medical conditions in the differential diagnosis, along with medications that may affect the periodontium.
Attribute the periodontitis solely to local plaque, with no further consideration of systemic factors.
Rule out systemic disease as a cause, since only medications can negatively affect the periodontium.
Ignore medications as a possible contributor, since only systemic disease can affect the periodontium.
